title: Account for high-route encoded setup and payload ownership
body:
PR3233 prices the ordered high-field ADD but leaves the surrounding `high_route.extents/execute` work open. This package derives an exact physical read/write/unit-move invoice for the unchanged caller's encoded setup, high-bank lifecycle, extent construction and intermediate disposal. It gives a uniform bound for that surrounding work while charging every kernel and complete native adapter call separately.

For high modulus `Q>1`, the complete high-bank lifecycle costs `10K + 65 bit_length(Q) + 159`, with the numerical-role count `K` explicit. Input width is also explicit. A reversed ADD retains three caller-owned payload banks at the relevant return cuts and pays both native swaps plus all three intermediate clearances; the borrowed original source and callee workspace are additional.

Evidence on Linux x86_64 / CPython 3.12.15:

- Ten unchanged-source fixtures cover all six compiled operation kinds, width one, multiple fibres/radices and an empty active route. Exact formulas, a raw physical meter and a separate observer agree; an independent q-adic endpoint oracle checks the result.
- The V=81 ordered/reversed words cost 59,701/175,505 total operations, of which 8,951/10,599 are setup and disposal outside the paid data calls.
- Seven controls pass normally and with `-I -O -Werror`. They check legal input-width and bank-size increments, inactive high operations, reversed ownership, an extra read, missing bank erasure, changed source bytes and a missing-swap fault distinguished by a one-hot payload.
- `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/high-route-setup-invoice` passes. Metadata/source pins, staged whitespace checks and all 32 committed publication/source bytes pass at `ac651ec18e62edf0baf3846cc4bf0a11d335c2b4`.

The written proof is conditional on successful execution and the named callee endpoint/head contracts. Fixture B1 calls use the elementary branch; this does not establish fitted all-width native correctness or a uniform tariff for the charged data calls. Finite-control costs, total backing, caller stock, selected cold replay and supplier admission remain outside scope. No new kappa or selected-frontier change. `TASK.json` records the changed stock-card scope and open next questions.

Canonical coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-19003396. The submission check covered 309 open PRs and 2,095 Discussion records with complete pagination. Canonical main/fork are synchronized and the branch is rebased on `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`.

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml and David Arias for the reached implementation and caller, Nick Petalas for the prefix/scaling invoices and handoff, commdata2338 for PR3233's ordered ADD, Arham Tahir for the countdown identity, ywz65 and Ross Richardson for earlier audits, and the retained PR2157/PR589/source lineage. Prepared by thakrarsagar with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate proof derivation and review; this is not independent human or proof-assistant review. Apache-2.0.
